description:
## Problem
The DataFrame memory guard (`check_sufficient_memory`, called in `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/benchmark_mixin.py` before load) estimates query-execution memory only. During the PR #4299 measurements, TPC-H dbgen workers alone summed to 2.6-3.1 GiB resident, which the per-engine floors (Polars/DataFusion 2.0, PySpark 4.0 GiB) do not cover. A run that generates data can exceed the host even when the guard accepts it. Not yet established: whether generation runs inside the same `benchbox run` before the guard, and the generation peak per benchmark and scale factor.

## Method
1. Trace the order of generation and the guard in one `benchbox run` with no cached data; record it here with file references.
2. Measure generation peak RSS (all generator processes) for TPC-H and TPC-DS at SF1 and SF10 (SF10 only on a host that can hold it) through `make heavy-run`.

## Decision gate (owner)
Present the measurements and these options, with a recommendation: (a) include a generation estimate in the guard when data is not cached; (b) a separate check before generation; (c) document only. Agents implement only the owner's choice.

## Guardrails
Timing and memory runs only through `make heavy-run` after `make heavy-status`; never force admission, set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK, disable the watchdog, or pass `--ignore-memory-warnings` without the owner's approval in that task. Never kill processes by pattern; the host is shared. Do not change generator parallelism or output to reduce memory as part of this item.
